headline: India Diesel Fuel Export Earnings Surge 50% to $27.2 Billion Amid Middle East Crisis
summary: Surging diesel and gasoline prices drove a 50% increase in India's fuel export value, reaching 2.59 trillion rupees ($27.2 billion) in the six months to September amidst Middle East supply disruptions.
why: India operates major refining complexes that supply refined petroleum products to global markets, capturing windfalls during international energy supply crises.

impacts.name: India
impacts.why: Higher refined product export prices boost foreign exchange earnings and net margins for Indian refiners.

why_moved: Spikes in refined fuel export earnings bolster trade balances and benefit domestic refining enterprises.
